column1: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS workspace.innovalab.business_cost_lines (id STRING NOT NULL, business_id STRING NOT NULL, concept STRING NOT NULL, behavior STRING NOT NULL, traceability STRING NOT NULL, amount_period DECIMAL(18,4) NOT NULL, notes STRING, created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS workspace.innovalab.businesses (id STRING NOT NULL, owner_user_id STRING NOT NULL, name STRING NOT NULL, business_type STRING, created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS workspace.innovalab.calc_cost_lines (id STRING NOT NULL, calculation_id STRING NOT NULL, scenario_id STRING, source_business_cost_id STRING NOT NULL, concept STRING NOT NULL, behavior STRING NOT NULL, traceability STRING NOT NULL, amount DECIMAL(18,4) NOT NULL, hours DECIMAL(18,4), hourly_rate DECIMAL(18,4), allocation_pct DECIMAL(18,4), created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS workspace.innovalab.calculations (id STRING NOT NULL, user_id STRING NOT NULL, business_id STRING NOT NULL, product_id STRING NOT NULL, status STRING NOT NULL, schema_version INT NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS workspace.innovalab.computed_results (id STRING NOT NULL, calculation_id STRING NOT NULL, scenario_id STRING, total_fixed DECIMAL(18,4) NOT NULL, variable_unit DECIMAL(18,4) NOT NULL, total_cost DECIMAL(18,4) NOT NULL, unit_cost DECIMAL(18,4) NOT NULL, contribution_margin_unit DECIMAL(18,4) NOT NULL, break_even_units DECIMAL(18,4) NOT NULL, break_even_sales DECIMAL(18,4) NOT NULL, computed_at TIMESTAMP, results_payload STRING);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS workspace.innovalab.costing_setup (calculation_id STRING NOT NULL, currency STRING NOT NULL, costing_period STRING NOT NULL, costing_unit STRING NOT NULL, estimated_volume DECIMAL(18,4) NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS workspace.innovalab.pricing_inputs (calculation_id STRING NOT NULL, margin_convention STRING NOT NULL, expected_margin_pct DECIMAL(18,4) NOT NULL, manual_price DECIMAL(18,4), created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS workspace.innovalab.products (id STRING NOT NULL, business_id STRING NOT NULL, name STRING NOT NULL, sku_or_slug STRING, is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS workspace.innovalab.profiles (id STRING NOT NULL, display_name STRING, created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS workspace.innovalab.scenarios (id STRING NOT NULL, calculation_id STRING NOT NULL, name STRING NOT NULL, is_base BOOLEAN NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL);
